scope: Actual application guide/shell, canonical member workspace opened through real exported module and native launcher, and deployed component reference. Three engines, light/dark, 320/1280, normal/200% root font-size override (explicit px-token text may remain unchanged). Injected test-only failed Inter @font-face; deployed font-family stack is never replaced. All external resources aborted and all API traffic GET-only to disposable loopback fixture or locally fulfilled profile reads. No persistence, application changes, physical devices or native assistive technology.
limits: Synthetic blocked Inter request proves unavailable-primary fallback; the application itself currently requests no optional external font/icon assets, so no actual production external-font outage was exercised.

Text metrics and native outcomes cover named surfaces/controls, not every label or operating-system font installation. FontFace error state and rejected load establish failure; fontCheckInter is diagnostic because WebKit returned true despite the rejected/error face in this local run.

200% root font-size override is not universal text enlargement: actual root/body/control font sizes are recorded; explicit px-token control text may stay unchanged. No physical zoom or software keyboard is exercised.
No whole-item acceptance is granted by this report.
